Name: Landshark Lunge
Components: V, M, S (The fang of a shark surrounded by pocket sand.)
Description: You have learned how to mold earth in a frightening manner, yet to do so, you must use your entire body. As part of your action when you cast this spell, you dive headfirst into the ground as if it were a liquid substance, until the end of your turn you gain a Burrowing speed equal to your walking speed. On the end of your turn, you are flung back to the surface on the nearest empty 5-foot space, when you do this, you may cause a crash of sharp rocks to appear up alongside you, resembling the sharp teeth of a shark's maw. Any creatures within a 10-feet radius of that space must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take 2d10 piercing damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 2nd.
